sources.title: Fine-Tune XLSR-Wav2Vec2 on Common Voice.ipynb - Colab
sources.snippet: It is much simpler and more efficient to use XLSR-Wav2Vec2 without a language model, but better results can be achieved by including a language model. For demonstration purposes, we fine-tune the wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53 on the low resource Turkish ASR dataset of Common Voice that contains just ~6h of validated training data.
